contract.validation: Strict exact-field OpenAPI/runtime model; location and assessment IDs bind to the route. Enforces migration-backed text, sample-size, evidence-array length/serialized-size, gate type, comparison operator and numeric-pair constraints. Evidence array elements are validated as JSON-serializable values without inventing an element schema.
contract.authorization: The existing private exact-location solution_lifecycle:review policy, signed tenant context, and active-human review requirements are unchanged. Evaluator identity is not projected; only the conflict boolean is returned.

verification.ruff_default: passed on changed source and tests
verification.python_compile: passed on changed source and tests

environment.database: not used; tests use mocked service results and cursor helpers

rollback: Revert the response model/route, focused test, and progress/evidence records; no database rollback is needed.
